# Auto-generated figure captions

Numbers come straight from the data; edit the wording, not the numbers.

**11_openloop_traces** - Open-loop speed traces at 6 constant-PWM settings (69–466 RPM). The PWM command is constant (zero jitter) yet the speed ripples: std 8.99 % of speed at 69 RPM and 2.26 % at 466 RPM. Same vertical span in all panels.

**individual/11_openloop_trace_0069rpm** - Open-loop speed at 69 RPM with constant PWM; every graph in this series spans the same 50 RPM.

**individual/11_openloop_trace_0161rpm** - Open-loop speed at 161 RPM with constant PWM; every graph in this series spans the same 50 RPM.

**individual/11_openloop_trace_0235rpm** - Open-loop speed at 235 RPM with constant PWM; every graph in this series spans the same 50 RPM.

**individual/11_openloop_trace_0300rpm** - Open-loop speed at 300 RPM with constant PWM; every graph in this series spans the same 50 RPM.

**individual/11_openloop_trace_0380rpm** - Open-loop speed at 380 RPM with constant PWM; every graph in this series spans the same 50 RPM.

**individual/11_openloop_trace_0466rpm** - Open-loop speed at 466 RPM with constant PWM; every graph in this series spans the same 50 RPM.

**individual/11_openloop_overlay_deviation** - All open-loop speeds with each mean removed so the ripple sizes can be compared directly.

**12_openloop_scaling** - Open-loop speed ripple versus speed (6 runs, 69–466 RPM). (a) Amplitude of the 1×, 2× and 12× shaft-order components; (b) total ripple as a percentage of speed. The 2× component follows a log–log slope of −0.81 ± 0.32 (R² = 0.62); a speed−independent torque ripple on a fixed inertia predicts −1, an encoder geometry error +1. The 1× component has slope 0.24 ± 0.19 (R² = 0.28) and shows no clear trend with speed.

**individual/12a_scaling_amplitude** - Open-loop speed ripple versus speed (6 runs, 69–466 RPM). (a) Amplitude of the 1×, 2× and 12× shaft-order components; (b) total ripple as a percentage of speed. The 2× component follows a log–log slope of −0.81 ± 0.32 (R² = 0.62); a speed−independent torque ripple on a fixed inertia predicts −1, an encoder geometry error +1. The 1× component has slope 0.24 ± 0.19 (R² = 0.28) and shows no clear trend with speed.

**individual/12b_ripple_percent** - Total open-loop speed ripple relative to speed: 9.0 % at 69 RPM down to 2.26 % at 466 RPM.

**13_openloop_orders** - Amplitude spectra of the open-loop speed signal with frequency normalised to the shaft rotation frequency. Peaks at integer orders show the ripple is tied to rotation. Components above 50 Hz (100 Hz sampling) alias into the band.

**individual/13_openloop_orders** - Amplitude spectra of the open-loop speed signal with frequency normalised to the shaft rotation frequency. Peaks at integer orders show the ripple is tied to rotation. Components above 50 Hz (100 Hz sampling) alias into the band.

**individual/11a_ol_power_vs_time** - Electrical power (W) after switching the PWM on, one line per duty.

**individual/11a_ol_power_vs_duty** - Steady-state electrical power (w) against the commanded duty, one point per run.

**individual/11a_ol_power_vs_rpm** - Steady-state electrical power (w) against the steady-state speed, one point per run.

**individual/11b_ol_current_vs_time** - Supply current (mA) after switching the PWM on, one line per duty.

**individual/11b_ol_current_vs_duty** - Steady-state supply current (ma) against the commanded duty, one point per run.

**individual/11b_ol_current_vs_rpm** - Steady-state supply current (ma) against the steady-state speed, one point per run.

**individual/11c_ol_voltage_vs_time** - Supply voltage (V) after switching the PWM on, one line per duty.

**individual/11c_ol_voltage_vs_duty** - Steady-state supply voltage (v) against the commanded duty, one point per run.

**00_summary_table** - Summary of all measured data (mean of repeats). See also metrics_*.csv for full per-run data.
